name: IOF Core, Supply Chain, Maintenance, Certification and Production Planning
description: The Core, Supply Chain, Maintenance, Certification and Production Planning ontologies of the Industrial Ontologies Foundry (IOF), developed by the IOF under the Open Applications Group (https://spec.industrialontologies.org) and licensed under MIT, from Release 202603. Core holds the notions common to manufacturing: agents and the roles they play, products, materials, equipment and engineered systems, planned and manufacturing processes, capabilities and functions, and the plans, specifications, identifiers and measurements that describe them. Supply Chain adds suppliers, buyers, carriers and distributors, the sourcing, shipping, storage and logistics processes between them, and the shipments, lots and locations they handle; Maintenance adds failures, failure modes and maintenance states, and the maintenance activities and work orders that answer them; Certification adds certifying bodies, attesting agents and processes, and the certificates they grant; Production Planning adds production plans and orders, process plans, operations and process steps, and the machines, tools and operators that carry them out. All are built on the Basic Formal Ontology (BFO 2020), which the closure of their owl:imports adds: each class is a node, each object property a relationship from its domain to its range (one direction per inverse pair), each datatype property a property, each class restriction a count, and each superclass an implied label.
